items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: But I mean Duke Ellington and Billy Strayhorn, those guys were cranking it out.

ctx.x: But I mean partly it probably is because I don’t write that much. I mean when I write I’m slow, whatever. But when it comes out it’s good, whatever comes out is good. But I mean Duke Ellington and Billy Strayhorn, those guys were cranking it out. They came up with all —it’s amazing, I mean it still is amazing, the titles they would come up with.
